data.notes: September’s confirmed calendar is Lisbon-heavy; no Portimão flagship music events were found confirmed for September 2026 yet.

events.title: Fischer-Z
events.summary: British new wave and alternative-rock band Fischer-Z return to Portugal for a 50th-anniversary concert at Coliseu dos Recreios. The venue listing confirms the September 4 date and 21:00 start.

events.title: The Weeknd: After Hours Til Dawn Tour with Playboi Carti
events.summary: The Weeknd brings the After Hours Til Dawn stadium tour to Lisbon for two Estádio do Restelo dates, with Playboi Carti listed as support. Live Nation confirms September 6 with an alternative September 5 date.

events.title: The Living Tombstone – Multiplayer Tour
events.summary: The electronic-rock duo The Living Tombstone play LAV - Lisboa Ao Vivo on September 9 as part of the Multiplayer Tour. Songkick lists Multiplayer Tour on the bill and confirms doors at 21:00.

events.title: The Neighbourhood – The Wourld Tour
events.summary: The Neighbourhood bring THE WOURLD TOUR to MEO Arena on September 12, with Nessa Barrett listed as support. Visit Lisboa confirms doors at 18:30 and show time at 20:00.

events.title: CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso – Free Spirits World Tour
events.summary: Argentine duo CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso bring their Free Spirits World Tour to Lisbon’s Sala Tejo on September 13. Live Nation confirms the date, venue, and 20:00 show time.

events.title: Sigur Rós – The Orchestral Tour
events.summary: Sigur Rós perform The Orchestral Tour at Sagres Campo Pequeno on September 17, accompanied by the Lisbon Sinfonietta Orchestra and the Ricercare Choir. The venue confirms doors at 20:00 and show time at 21:00.

events.title: Gentleman – Live 2026
events.summary: German reggae artist Gentleman returns to Portugal with Gentleman – Live 2026 at LAV - Lisboa Ao Vivo on September 18. The venue listing highlights his album Mad World and confirms a 21:30 start.

events.title: Phonica – Marisa Monte & Orquestra ao Vivo
events.summary: Marisa Monte presents Phonica with her band and a 55-piece symphony orchestra at MEO Arena on September 18. The arena listing confirms the 21:00 session and the orchestral format under maestro André Bachur.

events.title: Mac DeMarco
events.summary: Mac DeMarco plays LAV - Lisboa Ao Vivo on September 20, presenting his album Guitar. The venue listing confirms doors at 20:30 and concert start at 21:00.

events.title: Fat Freddy’s Drop
events.summary: Fat Freddy’s Drop return to Lisbon for a Sagres Campo Pequeno stop on September 23, celebrating the 21st anniversary of Based On A True Story. Visit Lisboa confirms the date and venue.

events.title: Ty Segall
events.summary: Ty Segall performs at LAV - Lisboa Ao Vivo on September 23. Fever’s ticket listing confirms the Lisbon date and Sala 1 at LAV as the venue.

events.title: Placebo – 30th Anniversary Tour
events.summary: Placebo open the Portugal leg of their 30th Anniversary Tour at Sagres Campo Pequeno on September 29. The venue confirms doors at 19:00 and show time at 20:00.
